rationale: Zone 1 set to 81.5% of protected line impedance (26.39 ohm) for underreach. Zone 2 covers protected line plus 55% of shortest backup line L_BC (15.77 ohm). Zone 3 covers protected line plus 122.5% of longest backup line L_BD (18.55 ohm), well below load encroachment limit of 121 ohm. Delays selected within coordination windows with proper grading.
